description: Schema for git worktree entities describing checked-out working trees and linkage to repositories.

owning-repository.description: Filesystem path of the git repository that owns this worktree. Present when this is a linked worktree; absent when this is a standalone (main) worktree.

target-branch.description: The branch this worktree's changes are compared against in the review view (e.g. 'main', 'develop').

computer-user-profile-id.description: Entity ID of the user-computer-profile this worktree is hosted on
